title: Grusch approaches Knapp and Corbell at a bar at the SCU event
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of Grusch approaches Knapp and Corbell at a bar at the SCU event, about c. 2022-2023 at Rocket City (Huntsville), Alabama, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: What happened is we were in Rocket City, Alabama.

plain: Jeremy Corbell, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that around 2022 or 2023, at an event in Huntsville, Alabama, known as Rocket City, a man named David Grusch came up to him and his colleague George Knapp at a bar. Corbell connects this meeting to the complaint Grusch filed with the Inspector General of the intelligence community, the internal watchdog for US spy agencies, which would mean Grusch was reaching out to people outside government before he went public.
